title: Castling
line: King and rook in one move, on either side.

steps.text: Castling moves the king and a rook in one move. It tucks the king away and brings the rook toward the middle.
Castle on the short side: move the king two squares toward the rook on h1.

wrong.e1f1: That moves the king only one square, and the rook stays in its corner.
wrong.h1f1: That moves only the rook. To castle, move the king two squares.
wrong.h1g1: That moves only the rook. To castle, move the king two squares.

steps.text: You may castle only if neither the king nor that rook has moved, and every square between them is empty.
White cannot castle on the long side yet. Tap every piece between the king and the rook on a1.
steps.after: The knight, the bishop and the queen must move out first.

steps.text: Here the way is clear. Castle on the long side: the king moves two squares toward the rook on a1.
